attempts.text: {"claims":[{"claim_text":"Support for a Victims' Rights Amendment to the United States Constitution consistent with fundamental Constitutional protections.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Victims must have a voice in trial and other proceedings.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Victims' safety must be a factor in the sentencing and release of their attackers.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Victims must be notified when an offender is released back into their community.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Victims must have a right to compensation from their attacker.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The justice system should place victims and their families in their rightful place.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"80 percent of criminals behind bars are implicated in crimes related to drug and alcohol abuse.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Support for testing prisoners for drugs while they are in jail.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Support for treating prisoners for addictions.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Support for breaking up drug rings inside the prison system.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Al Gore believes prisoners should get clean to get out and stay clean to stay out, and this deal should be non-negotiable.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
